profile.headline: Engineering Manager | AI & Cloud Platforms | LLM, RAG & Agentic Systems in Production | .NET · Azure · Python | PMP
profile.summary:
I lead engineering teams building and running systems where failure isn't an option and data can't leave the building.

I'm currently an Engineering Manager at the Cook County Treasurer's Office, where I lead a team of 10+ engineers delivering cloud-native financial platforms that process $16B+ in annual transactions at 99.9% uptime. My work spans architecture, delivery, security posture, and the policies that govern how we build.

Over the last two years I've focused on applied AI in environments with hard constraints. I designed and operate a self-hosted LLM platform — Llama 3 on Ollama with retrieval-augmented generation over internal documents, an embedding pipeline, vector search, and source-cited output — running entirely inside our network with zero data egress. I also built an agentic automation engine in Python and Playwright that executes multi-step workflows end to end against external systems, with stateful pause/resume control, concurrency limits, and retry handling.

Alongside building those systems, I set the standards that govern them: what data may be processed by which models, mandatory human review of AI-generated output, and the approval path for new use cases. Most organizations treat building AI and governing AI as two different jobs. I've done both, in a place where the compliance constraints are real.

Before this I spent eight years across project management and lead engineering roles — running distributed teams, applying formal PM methodology, and re-engineering processes rather than just automating them.

What I care about: shipping things that work, teams that grow, and technology decisions that hold up under audit.
Currently going deeper on model training, fine-tuning, and evaluation, and on healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7).

Open to conversations about AI platform leadership roles in regulated industries.

📍 Chicago | Open to hybrid and remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead a team of 10+ engineers delivering cloud-native tax collection and refund systems processing $16B+ annually at 99.9% uptime.

- Designed and operate a self-hosted LLM platform (Llama 3, Ollama, FastAPI, React, Docker) with RAG over internal documents — embedding pipeline, vector search, chunking strategy, source-cited responses — with zero sensitive data leaving the network.

- Architected an agentic automation engine (Python, Playwright, FastAPI, SQL Server) executing multi-step workflows against external portals with pause/resume/stop control, concurrency limits, and retry handling.

- Own the organization's AI usage standards: which data may be processed by which models, mandatory human review of AI output, and the approval path for new use cases.

- Led migration of legacy on-premises .NET applications to Azure, improving performance ~30%.

- Established CI/CD, automated testing, structured logging, and incident response practices that reduced mean time to recovery.

- Hire, mentor, and grow engineers; run Agile delivery in Azure DevOps and Jira.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Writes code that is easily maintainable, highly reliable and demonstrates knowledge of common programming best practices.
With some supervision and oversight, complete moderately complex development tasks on time and with high quality.
Is continually striving to learn applicable technologies to the job and rectify deficits in their technical knowledge that stops them from being able to contribute when needed.
Stays current with current software architecture and system design concepts.
Is proactive and shows urgency and does what is necessary to get the job done and cares about impacts to our customers.
Respond quickly and effectively to production issues and take responsibility for seeing those issues through resolution.
Possess strong communication skills and can communicate complex technical problems in a manner non-technical people can understand.
Coordinate with QA, Ops, and other Development Teams effectively.
Familiar with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
